title_sq: LEDA (CAPITAL115861) Apartament 3+1+2 për shitje, Kopshti Botanik, Tiranë - 340,000 €
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 3+1+2+ mundesi per Post Parkimi, tek Kopshtit Botanik, prane "Pizzeria Pavaroti". I vendosur në katin e pare banim (i dyte teknik) te nje ndertese 7-kateshe me ashensor ndertuar ne vitin 2008.
Siperfaqja neto: 174 m²
Organizimi i apartamentit eshte i rregullt. Me ane te nje koridori shperndares jepet akses per ne kuzhinen qe eshte e lidhur me dhomen e ndenjes dhe veranden, te treja dhomat e gjumit dhe tualetet. Dhoma matrimoniale ka garderobe private dhe nje ballkon personal. Per ta kuptuar me qarte organizimin, mund te shikoni planimetrine dhe videon. Punimet e brendshme, me cilesoret per kohen. Izolim kunder zhurmave ne muret ndarese me komshinjte. I gjithe apartamenti eshte i shtruar me parket druri. Dritaret, vetratat dhe dyert e verandes dhe ballkonit jane me xham tripleks dhe izolimi me dru dural nga brenda dhe dural+grila nga jashte. Apartamenti eshte i pajisur me sistem alarmi dhe kamera te jashtme (2 ne verande dhe 1 ne ballkonin e lidhur me dhomen matrimoniale). Eshte pajisur me panel diellor ne tarrace. Sistem ngrohje-ftohje qendrore (paisja Daikin e vendosur ne verande), brenda eshte e pajisur me falkonj: 3 ne dhomen e ndenjes, nga 1 ne secilen dhome gjumi, dhe 1 ne garderobe. Ne secilin tualet ka element ngrohes dhe ftohes ne mur, ndersa tualeti i madh eshte i pajisur me jacuzzi.
Parkimi nuk është i përfshirë në çmim. Pra është ekstra.
Per me shume informacion, na kontaktoni!
title_en: LEDA (CAPITAL115861) Apartment 3+1+2 for sale, Botanical Garden, Tirana - €340,000
description_en: 3+1+2 apartment for sale, possibility for Post Parking, in the Botanical Garden, near "Pizzeria Pavaroti". Located on the first residential floor (second technical) of a 7-story building with an elevator built in 2008. Net area: 174 m² The organization of the apartment is regular. Through a distribution corridor, access is given to the kitchen, which is connected to the living room and the veranda, the three bedrooms and the toilets. The matrimonial room has a private wardrobe and a personal balcony. To understand the organization more clearly, you can see the floor plan and the video. Internal works, with quality for the time. Isolation against noise in the partition walls with neighbors. The whole apartment is laid with wooden parquet. The windows, windows and doors of the veranda and balcony have triplex glass and insulation with dural wood from the inside and dural + shutters from the outside. The apartment is equipped with an alarm system and external cameras (2 on the veranda and 1 on the balcony connected to the master bedroom). It is equipped with a solar panel on the terrace. Central heating-cooling system (Daikin unit located in the veranda), inside is equipped with fans: 3 in the living room, 1 in each bedroom, and 1 in the wardrobe. In each toilet there is a heating and cooling element in the wall, while the large toilet is equipped with a jacuzzi. Parking is not included in the price. So it's extra.
